_comment: Worker-side install manifest for Aurora, keyed by skill. Runners read this (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §4.B). Paths are resolved ON THE WORKER; the laptop MCP never needs them. 'launcher' may use $HPC_LOAM_HOME-relative paths at the runner, but here we give absolutes the worker can see. Moving an install = edit this one file.

proteinmpnn._note: proteinmpnn already resolves via an exported $PROTEINMPNN_PATH on the worker (verified 2026-11-11). The manifest records that rather than duplicating the path; a runner should prefer $PROTEINMPNN_PATH when present.
